findings.message: GSAP animation sets visibility on a clip element. Selector "#scene1" resolves to element <div id="scene1" class="scene clip">. The framework manages clip visibility, and autoAlpha writes visibility as well as opacity. Do not animate these properties on clip elements.
findings.fixHint: Remove the visibility/display/autoAlpha tween, or move the content into a child <div> and target that instead.

findings.message: Font family used without @font-face declaration: cascadia code. These are not in the auto-resolved font list, so the renderer cannot supply them automatically. Text will fall back to a generic font, producing incorrect typography in the video.
findings.fixHint: Add @font-face { font-family: '...'; src: url('capture/assets/fonts/...woff2'); } for each font family, pointing to the captured .woff2 files, or switch to a Google Fonts family. An OS font such as PingFang SC or Hiragino Sans renders locally from the installed copy, but a cloud render has no copy and refuses it.
